# Aria Magic Voice & Harry App Store — LLMs Knowledge Base

> Last Updated: 2026-10-22

## Overview
Aria Magic Voice is an on-device, privacy-first AI smart input method and voice dictation software developed by Peace & Light for macOS and iOS (with Android build available). It features built-in Rime smart pinyin engine, real-time local speech-to-text dictation, automatic punctuation, filler word removal, and seamless switching between English and Chinese without sending any audio or keystroke data to the cloud.

- Official Website: https://ariamagicvoice.com/
- App Store & Product Details: https://ariamagicvoice.com/apps/aria-magic-voice/
- Web App Directory: https://ariamagicvoice.com/apps/

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **Local Smart Pinyin Input Method**: High-accuracy local pinyin typing engine (Rime core), intelligent candidate ranking, multi-syllable segmentation, custom lexicon support, and fast typing performance.
- **Offline Voice Dictation**: Operates 100% locally on Apple Silicon and modern mobile chips. Zero audio uploaded to cloud, zero keystroke logging, private and secure.
- **Mixed English & Chinese Speech (Code-Switching)**: Fluidly dictates mixed Chinese and English sentences without manual mode switching.
- **Adaptive Vocabulary Learning**: Local engine learns custom technical terms, names, and user idioms privately on device.
- **Multi-Device Support**: Full input method implementation for macOS, iOS (iPhone & iPad with 9-key and 26-key layouts), and Android.
